---
description: Source reconciliation and identity rules for Canadian racewalking data
applyTo: "**"
---

Prefer official race results over summaries and rankings for conflicting marks; finer precision is supporting evidence, not proof. Prefer Canadian and Quebec sources for Canadian and francophone names. Record minor conflicts and source links alongside a clearly identified provisional choice rather than omitting the result; do not treat an unverified alternate spelling as a confirmed alias. Consult [project context](../../context.md) and [handoff](../../HANDOFF.md) for full conventions and remaining work.
